description: This file contains implementation of operators and expression evaluation logic for a build system or scripting language, including classes and functions for handling assignment, arithmetic, comparison, and logical operators, as well as error handling.

classes.name: ValueDestination
classes.description: Helper class for managing assignment destinations in different scopes or lists, supporting initialization, value retrieval, and setting.

methods.name: ValueDestination::Init
methods.description: Initializes the destination for assignment, determining if it's a scope variable, list element, or scope accessor.

methods.name: ValueDestination::GetExistingValue
methods.description: Retrieves the current value in the destination scope or list element.

methods.name: ValueDestination::GetExistingMutableValueIfExists
methods.description: Retrieves a mutable reference to the existing value if it exists and can be modified.

methods.name: ValueDestination::SetValue
methods.description: Sets a new value at the destination.

methods.name: ExecuteBinaryOperator
methods.description: Performs evaluation of binary operators (+, -, ==, !=, <, >, &&, ||, etc.) based on the operator token, operands, and scope, including handling of assignment and in-place modification.
